verdict.rationale: Maritime runs each agent, including coding agents like Claude Code and Codex, in its own cloud micro-VM. Secrets are injected only into that agent's VM, and scoped keys limit blast radius. That keeps agent-run code off the developer's own infrastructure, but the evidence never presents this as a sandbox for untrusted code. missing for 10: an explicit untrusted-code sandbox or code-execution API, documented isolation guarantees (network egress limits, tenant isolation, resource caps), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute untrusted, AI-generated code without risking my own infrastructure
